title.zh: 卷74 志四十九 地理二十一 雲南
title.raw: 卷74 志四十九 地理二十一 雲南

translations.literal: Treatise 49
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 49

translations.literal: Geography 21
translations.idiomatic: Geography 21

translations.literal: Yunnan
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan

translations.literal: Yunnan: outer frontier territory of Liang Province in the Yugong.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan: in the Yugong it lay in the outer frontier zone of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 清初沿明制，置承宣布政使司，為雲南省，設巡撫，治雲南府，並設雲貴總督，兩省互駐。

translations.literal: In the early Qing, following the Ming system, a Provincial Administration Commission was established, making Yunnan a province; a governor was appointed with his seat at Yunnan Prefecture, and a Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general was also established, with the two provinces taking turns as his residence.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Qing the Ming arrangements were retained: a Provincial Administration Commission was set up and Yunnan constituted a province, with a provincial governor seated at Yunnan Prefecture and a Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general whose headquarters alternated between the two provinces.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，改雲南總督，駐曲靖。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi, the post was changed to Governor of Yunnan, stationed at Qujing.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Kangxi reign the office was retitled Governor of Yunnan and stationed at Qujing.

sentences.zh: 三年，裁貴州總督並雲南，駐貴陽。

translations.literal: In the third year, the Governor of Guizhou was abolished and merged with Yunnan, with headquarters at Guiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the separate Guizhou governorship was abolished and combined with Yunnan, with the seat at Guiyang.

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, the headquarters were moved to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year the headquarters were transferred to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，定雲貴總督兼轄廣西。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, it was fixed that the Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general would also administer Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Yongzheng reign the Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general was given concurrent jurisdiction over Guangxi.

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, concurrent administration of Guangxi was discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year jurisdiction over Guangxi was withdrawn.

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, a Governor of Yunnan was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Qianlong reign a separate Governor of Yunnan was appointed.

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, it was changed back to Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the office was again consolidated as the Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

translations.literal: During the Guangxu period, the provincial governor was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: During the Guangxu period the provincial governorship was abolished.

translations.literal: It administered twenty prefectures and one directly controlled department.
translations.idiomatic: The province comprised twenty prefectures and one department under direct provincial control.

sentences.zh: 康熙五年，降北勝直隸州為州，隸大理。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Kangxi, Beisheng Directly Controlled Department was reduced to a department subordinate to Dali.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Kangxi, Beisheng was demoted from a directly controlled department to an ordinary department under Dali Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八年，降尋甸府為州，隸曲靖。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Xundian Prefecture was reduced to a department subordinate to Qujing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Xundian Prefecture was demoted to a department under Qujing.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，升北勝州為永北府，省永寧。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year, Beisheng Department was promoted to Yongbei Prefecture, and Yongning was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year Beisheng Department was raised to Yongbei Prefecture and Yongning was eliminated.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年，改威遠土州為直隸廳。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongzheng, Weiyuan Native Department was changed to a directly controlled subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongzheng the native department of Weiyuan was converted into a directly controlled subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 四年，割四川之東川府來隸。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Dongchuan Prefecture was detached from Sichuan and placed under Yunnan's jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Dongchuan Prefecture was transferred from Sichuan to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 五年，以四川烏蒙、鎮雄二府來隸。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Wumeng and Zhenxiong prefectures were transferred from Sichuan to Yunnan's jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the Sichuan prefectures of Wumeng and Zhenxiong were annexed to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 六年，降鎮雄為州，屬烏蒙。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Zhenxiong was reduced to a department subordinate to Wumeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Zhenxiong was demoted to a department under Wumeng.

sentences.zh: 東川、鎮雄，元屬雲南，明屬四川。

translations.literal: Dongchuan and Zhenxiong belonged to Yunnan under the Yuan and to Sichuan under the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Dongchuan and Zhenxiong had been part of Yunnan in the Yuan and of Sichuan in the Ming.

sentences.zh: 烏蒙，元屬四川，明初屬雲南，後改屬四川。

translations.literal: Wumeng belonged to Sichuan under the Yuan; in the early Ming it belonged to Yunnan, and was later transferred to Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wumeng had been under Sichuan in the Yuan; in the early Ming it was assigned to Yunnan, then later returned to Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 七年置普洱、八年置開化二府。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Pu'er Prefecture was established; in the eighth year Kaihua Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: Pu'er Prefecture was established in the seventh year and Kaihua Prefecture in the eighth.

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Wumeng was renamed Zhaotong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Wumeng was redesignated Zhaotong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十一年，永北降直隸廳。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year of Qianlong, Yongbei was reduced to a directly controlled subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year of Qianlong Yongbei Prefecture was demoted to a directly controlled subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，廣西、武定、元江、鎮沅四府降直隸州，景東、蒙化二府皆降直隸廳，省姚安屬楚雄，改鶴慶府為州，屬麗江。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year, the four prefectures of Guangxi, Wuding, Yuanjiang, and Zhenyuan were reduced to directly controlled departments; Jingdong and Menghua prefectures were both reduced to directly controlled subprefectures; Yao'an was abolished and attached to Chuxiong; Heqing Prefecture was changed to a department subordinate to Lijiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year the prefectures of Guangxi, Wuding, Yuanjiang, and Zhenyuan were demoted to directly controlled departments; Jingdong and Menghua became directly controlled subprefectures; Yao'an was eliminated and placed under Chuxiong; and Heqing Prefecture was reduced to a department under Lijiang.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二十四年，升騰越州為直隸廳。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Jiaqing, Tengyue Department was promoted to a directly controlled subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of Jiaqing Tengyue Department was raised to a directly controlled subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，改分防同知，又改鎮沅直隸州為直隸廳。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang, the defense subprefect was changed; Zhenyuan Directly Controlled Department was also changed to a directly controlled subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daoguang the defense subprefect's post was reorganized, and Zhenyuan Directly Controlled Department was converted into a directly controlled subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 光緒十三年，置鎮邊撫夷直隸廳。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Guangxu, Zhenbian Pacification of the Yi Directly Controlled Subprefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Guangxu the directly controlled subprefecture of Zhenbian Pacification of the Yi was established.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，升鎮雄州為直隸廳。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Zhenxiong Department was promoted to a directly controlled subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Zhenxiong Department was raised to a directly controlled subprefecture.

translations.literal: On the east, to Sicheng in Guangxi;
translations.idiomatic: To the east, as far as Sicheng in Guangxi;

translations.literal: seven hundred fifty li.
translations.idiomatic: a distance of seven hundred fifty li.

translations.literal: On the south, to the border of Jiaozhi;
translations.idiomatic: To the south, to the frontier with Jiaozhi;

translations.literal: seven hundred fifty li.
translations.idiomatic: a distance of seven hundred fifty li.

translations.literal: On the north, to Huili in Sichuan;
translations.idiomatic: To the north, as far as Huili in Sichuan;

translations.literal: four hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: a distance of four hundred li.

translations.literal: On the west, to Tianma Pass, adjoining the border of Burma.
translations.idiomatic: To the west, to Tianma Pass on the Burmese frontier;

translations.literal: two thousand three hundred ten li.
translations.idiomatic: a distance of two thousand three hundred ten li.

translations.literal: Southwest: British-ruled Burma.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest lay British Burma.

sentences.zh: 光緒中，曾紀澤謀與英勘界，索八募，復我太平江以南漢龍、天馬、虎踞、鐵壁四關侵地，議未決。

translations.literal: During the Guangxu period, Zeng Jize sought to survey the boundary with Britain, demanding Bamaw and the recovery of the encroached territory at the four passes of Hanlong, Tianma, Huju, and Tiebi south of the Taiping River; the negotiations were unresolved.
translations.idiomatic: During the Guangxu period Zeng Jize negotiated a boundary survey with Britain, demanding Bamaw and the return of the four passes south of the Taiping River—Hanlong, Tianma, Huju, and Tiebi—where Chinese territory had been encroached upon; no agreement was reached.

translations.literal: Xue Fucheng succeeded him and vigorously upheld the previous plan.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Fucheng succeeded him and pressed hard for the earlier demarcation.

sentences.zh: 騰越西以伊洛瓦諦江源流為界，江東野人山地概歸中國，尚可由大盈江之新街入伊洛瓦諦，經阿瓦至仰光海口行輪，又索還故壤二千餘里。

translations.literal: West of Tengyue the boundary was to follow the headwaters of the Irrawaddy; the wild hill country east of the river was to belong entirely to China; passage by steamer from Xinjie on the Daying River into the Irrawaddy, through Ava to the port of Rangoon, would still be possible; and more than two thousand li of former territory was also to be recovered.
translations.idiomatic: West of Tengyue the boundary would run along the headwaters of the Irrawaddy, with the hill tracts east of the river assigned to China; steam navigation from Xinjie on the Daying River into the Irrawaddy, via Ava to the port of Rangoon, would remain open; and more than two thousand li of former territory was to be restored.

sentences.zh: 及中東事起，俄、法、德居間，後贈法以紅江甌脫及孟俄地，英藉口改薛約，割科干，復許以滇緬鐵路，而邊事日棘，片馬不守矣。

translations.literal: When the Eastern Question arose, Russia, France, and Germany intervened; China later ceded to France the Hong River enclave and the Meng'e territory; Britain used this as a pretext to revise Xue's agreement, annexed Kokang, and was also granted the Yunnan-Burma Railway; border affairs grew daily more pressing, and even Pianma could not be held.
translations.idiomatic: When the Eastern Question erupted, Russia, France, and Germany intervened; China later ceded the Hong River enclave and Meng'e territory to France; Britain seized the occasion to revise Xue's treaty, annexed Kokang, and secured rights to the Yunnan-Burma Railway as well; frontier tensions mounted, and even Pianma was lost.

sentences.zh: 廣二千五百一十里，袤一千一百五十里。

translations.literal: Its width is two thousand five hundred ten li and its length one thousand one hundred fifty li.
translations.idiomatic: The province measures two thousand five hundred ten li from east to west and one thousand one hundred fifty li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高二十九度三十分至二十一度四十分。

translations.literal: North latitude from twenty-nine degrees thirty minutes to twenty-one degrees forty minutes.
translations.idiomatic: It lies between 29°30′ and 21°40′ north latitude.

sentences.zh: 京師偏西十度二十九分至十九度十分。

translations.literal: West of the capital from ten degrees twenty-nine minutes to nineteen degrees ten minutes.
translations.idiomatic: It lies between 10°29′ and 19°10′ west of Beijing.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，編戶一百五十四萬八千一十四，口六百四十萬三千九百三。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong, registered households numbered 1,548,014 and population 6,403,903.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuantong there were 1,548,014 registered households and a population of 6,403,903.

sentences.zh: 共領府十四，直隸廳六，直隸州三，廳十二，州二十六，縣四十一；

translations.literal: In all it administered fourteen prefectures, six directly controlled subprefectures, three directly controlled departments, twelve subprefectures, twenty-six departments, and forty-one counties;
translations.idiomatic: In all it comprised fourteen prefectures, six directly controlled subprefectures, three directly controlled departments, twelve subprefectures, twenty-six departments, and forty-one counties;

sentences.zh: 又土府一，土州三，土司十八。

translations.literal: also one native prefecture, three native departments, and eighteen native chieftaincies.
translations.idiomatic: as well as one native prefecture, three native departments, and eighteen native chieftaincies.

sentences.zh: 驛路：東達貴州普安，東南達廣西百色，西達緬甸八募，西南達緬甸景東。

translations.literal: Postal routes: east to Pu'an in Guizhou; southeast to Baise in Guangxi; west to Bamaw in Burma; southwest to Jingdong in Burma.
translations.idiomatic: Postal routes ran east to Pu'an in Guizhou, southeast to Baise in Guangxi, west to Bamaw in Burma, and southwest to Jingdong in Burma.

translations.literal: Railway: Yunnan-Vietnam.
translations.idiomatic: Railway: the Yunnan-Vietnam line.

sentences.zh: 電線：東北通重慶，西通八募，東南通南寧。

translations.literal: Telegraph lines: northeast to Chongqing; west to Bamaw; southeast to Nanning.
translations.idiomatic: Telegraph lines ran northeast to Chongqing, west to Bamaw, and southeast to Nanning.

translations.literal: Yunnan Prefecture: strategically important, busy, taxing, and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan Prefecture: strategically important, busy, taxing, and difficult to administer.

translations.literal: Seat of the Yunnan-Wuding circuit intendant for patrol and grain storage.
translations.idiomatic: Seat of the Yunnan-Wuding circuit intendant for patrol and grain storage.

sentences.zh: 總督、巡撫，布政、提學、提法三使，鹽法、巡警、勸業各道駐。

translations.literal: The governor-general, provincial governor, the three commissioners for civil administration, education, and judicial affairs, and the intendants for salt administration, police patrol, and industrial promotion were all stationed here.
translations.idiomatic: It housed the governor-general, provincial governor, the three provincial commissioners (civil, educational, and judicial), and the intendants for salt, police patrol, and industrial promotion.

sentences.zh: 東北距京師八千二百里，廣三百七十里，袤二百九十八里。

translations.literal: Northeast from the capital eight thousand two hundred li; width three hundred seventy li; length two hundred ninety-eight li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay eight thousand two hundred li northeast of the capital, measuring three hundred seventy li across and two hundred ninety-eight li from north to south.

translations.literal: North latitude twenty-five degrees six minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its latitude was 25°06′ north.

sentences.zh: 京師偏西十三度三十七分。

translations.literal: West of the capital thirteen degrees thirty-seven minutes.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 13°37′ west of Beijing.

translations.literal: It administered four departments and seven counties.
translations.idiomatic: It comprised four departments and seven counties.

translations.literal: Kunming: strategically important, busy, taxing, and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Kunming: strategically important, busy, taxing, and difficult to administer.

translations.literal: Attached [to the prefectural seat].
translations.idiomatic: Its seat adjoined that of the prefecture.

translations.literal: Within the city: Wuhua Mountain and Luoshan.
translations.idiomatic: Within the city walls stood Wuhua Mountain and Luoshan.

sentences.zh: 山有潮音洞，山側有翠湖。

translations.literal: On the mountain is Chaoyin Cave; beside the mountain is Cuihu Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Wuhua Mountain has Chaoyin Cave, and Cuihu Lake lies at its foot.

translations.literal: East: Yingwu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east: Yingwu Mountain.

translations.literal: West: Taihua and Juxian.
translations.idiomatic: To the west: Taihua and Juxian mountains.

translations.literal: South: Wande.
translations.idiomatic: To the south: Wande Mountain.

translations.literal: North: Shangshan.
translations.idiomatic: To the north: Shangshan.

translations.literal: Northeast: Longquan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast: Longquan Mountain.

translations.literal: Southwest: Biji Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest: Biji Mountain.

sentences.zh: 盤龍江自嵩明入，西南流，逕城東，合銀棱河，至縣南，匯為滇池。

translations.literal: The Panlong River enters from Songming, flows southwest, passes east of the city, joins the Yinling River, and at the south of the county gathers into Dianchi.
translations.idiomatic: The Panlong River enters from Songming, flows southwest past the east side of the city, joins the Yinling River, and south of the county seat forms Dianchi Lake.

sentences.zh: 滇池一名昆明池，長百二十餘里，縣東諸水入焉，下流折入昆陽州曰海口，即螳螂川上游。

translations.literal: Dianchi, also called Kunming Pool, is more than one hundred twenty li long; various streams east of the county enter it; its lower course turns into Kunyang Department at Haikou, the upper reach of the Tanglang River.
translations.idiomatic: Dianchi, also known as Kunming Pool, stretches more than one hundred twenty li; streams east of the county feed into it; its outlet at Haikou in Kunyang Department marks the upper Tanglang River.

sentences.zh: 金棱河自城東北松華壩分盤龍口水入滇池。

translations.literal: The Jinling River branches from the Panlong River mouth at Songhua Dam northeast of the city and enters Dianchi.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinling River splits from the Panlong at Songhua Dam northeast of the city and flows into Dianchi.

sentences.zh: 寶象河自嵩明入，西南流，逕城南，亦入滇池。

translations.literal: The Baoxiang River enters from Songming, flows southwest, passes south of the city, and also enters Dianchi.
translations.idiomatic: The Baoxiang River enters from Songming, flows southwest past the south wall, and likewise empties into Dianchi.

translations.literal: West: Biji Pass and Gaoyao Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the west: Biji Pass and Gaoyao Pass.

translations.literal: East: Jinma Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the east: Jinma Pass.

translations.literal: One subprefect, stationed at Nanguan.
translations.idiomatic: One subprefect was garrisoned at Nanguan.

translations.literal: Two courier stations: Banqiao and Dianyang.
translations.idiomatic: Two courier stations: Banqiao and Dianyang.

translations.literal: Two garrison posts: Kunming and Banqiao.
translations.idiomatic: Two military posts: Kunming and Banqiao.

translations.literal: Fumin: simple.
translations.idiomatic: Fumin: administratively simple.

translations.literal: Seventy li northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay seventy li northwest of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: East: Tianma Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east: Tianma Mountain.

translations.literal: West: Wolong and Yuping.
translations.idiomatic: To the west: Wolong and Yuping mountains.

translations.literal: South: Lingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: To the south: Lingzhi Mountain.

translations.literal: North: Fahua Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north: Fahua Mountain.

sentences.zh: 螳螂川自安寧入，納城西北農納水，入武定州祿勸，為普渡河。

translations.literal: The Tanglang River enters from Anning, receives Nongna Water northwest of the city, enters Luquan in Wuding Department, and becomes the Pudu River.
translations.idiomatic: The Tanglang River enters from Anning, absorbs the Nongna stream northwest of the city, passes through Luquan in Wuding Department, and becomes the Pudu River.

sentences.zh: 大營河出昆明西北山，西流入境，洞溪水來會，西至城北入螳螂川，清水河從之。

translations.literal: The Daying River issues from the mountains northwest of Kunming, enters the county flowing west; Dongxi Stream joins it; west to the north of the city it enters the Tanglang River, and the Qingshui River follows the same course.
translations.idiomatic: The Daying River rises in the hills northwest of Kunming and enters from the west; the Dongxi stream joins it; west of the city it flows into the Tanglang River, followed by the Qingshui River.

translations.literal: Yiliang: strategically important and busy.
translations.idiomatic: Yiliang: strategically important and busy.

translations.literal: One hundred twenty li east of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred twenty li east of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: North: Wanshou.
translations.idiomatic: To the north: Wanshou Mountain.

translations.literal: South: Zhishan.
translations.idiomatic: To the south: Zhishan.

translations.literal: East: Kerongrong Mountain, the county's guardian mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the east: Kerongrong Mountain, the county's guardian peak.

translations.literal: West: Shiyan.
translations.idiomatic: To the west: Shiyan Mountain.

translations.literal: Southeast: Luotuo Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast: Luotuo Mountain.

translations.literal: Southwest: Fenghuang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest: Fenghuang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西：大城江，自河陽之楊宗海流入，逕城西北，折東南，分二支，同入大池江。

translations.literal: West: the Dacheng River enters from Yangzonghai in Heyang, passes northwest of the city, turns southeast, divides into two branches, and both enter the Dachi River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west, the Dacheng River enters from Yangzonghai in Heyang, flows past the northwest of the city, turns southeast, splits into two branches, and both join the Dachi River.

sentences.zh: 大池江即八達河，為南盤江上流。

translations.literal: The Dachi River is the Bada River, the upper reach of the Nanpan River.
translations.idiomatic: The Dachi River is the Bada River, the upper course of the Nanpan.

translations.literal: Northwest there is Tangchi.
translations.idiomatic: In the northwest is the hot spring district of Tangchi.

translations.literal: Songming Department: strategically important and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Songming Department: strategically important and difficult to administer.

translations.literal: One hundred thirty li northeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred thirty li northeast of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: Within the city: Huanglong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Within the city walls stood Huanglong Mountain.

translations.literal: East: Matou.
translations.idiomatic: To the east: Matou Mountain.

translations.literal: West: Lingyun and Denghua.
translations.idiomatic: To the west: Lingyun and Denghua mountains.

sentences.zh: 西北：東葛勒山，元梁王結寨地。

translations.literal: Northwest: Donggele Mountain, where the Yuan Prince of Liang once fortified a stockade.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest: Donggele Mountain, site of a fortified camp once held by the Yuan Prince of Liang.

translations.literal: South: Fengxi and Shihua Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south: Fengxi and Shihua Mountain.

sentences.zh: 龍巨河一曰龍濟溪，自尋甸入，南流匯為嘉利澤，一名楊林海，逕城東南，納楊梅河、對龍河諸水，匯為澤，周百餘里。

translations.literal: The Longju River, also called Longji Stream, enters from Xundian, flows south and gathers into Jiali Marsh, also called Yanglin Lake; it passes southeast of the city, receives the Yangmei River, Duilong River, and other streams, gathers into a marsh more than one hundred li in circumference.
translations.idiomatic: The Longju River, also known as Longji Stream, entered from Xundian and flowed south to form Jiali Marsh—also called Yanglin Lake. It ran past the southeast of the city, absorbed the Yangmei and Duilong rivers and other tributaries, and gathered into a marsh more than one hundred li around.

sentences.zh: 西：點蒼山，高六十里，山椒懸瀑，注為十八溪，綿亙百餘里，府之鎮山也，西拱縣城如抱弓然。

translations.literal: West: Diancang Mountain, sixty li high; cascades hang from its peaks and pour forth as the Eighteen Streams, stretching more than one hundred li—it is the prefecture's guardian mountain, curving west to embrace the county seat like a drawn bow.
translations.idiomatic: To the west stood Diancang Mountain, sixty li high, with cascades spilling from its ridges to form the Eighteen Streams across more than one hundred li—the prefecture's guardian peak, arching west around the county seat like a drawn bow.

sentences.zh: 西洱河，亦名洱海，形如月抱珥，亦曰珥河。

translations.literal: The Xi'er River, also called Erhai, shaped like the moon cradling an ear pendant—is also called the Er River.
translations.idiomatic: The Xi'er River, also known as Erhai, was shaped like the moon cradling an ear pendant and was also called the Er River.

sentences.zh: 縣東五里，即古葉榆澤，源出浪穹北，境內諸水入焉。

translations.literal: Five li east of the county seat; this is the ancient Yeyu Marsh; its source lies north of Langqiong, and all waters within the territory flow into it.
translations.idiomatic: Five li east of the county seat lay the ancient Yeyu Marsh, fed from north of Langqiong by every stream within the territory.

sentences.zh: 長百三十里，闊三十九里，下流會樣備江，逕趙州入蒙化。

translations.literal: One hundred thirty li long and thirty-nine li wide; downstream it joins the Yangbei River, passes through Zhaozhou, and enters Menghua.
translations.idiomatic: It measured one hundred thirty li long and thirty-nine li wide; downstream it joined the Yangbei River, passed through Zhaozhou, and entered Menghua.

sentences.zh: 北：上關，亦曰龍首關，又曰石門關。

sentences.zh: 諺曰：「蒼山雪，洱海月，上關花，下關風。」

translations.literal: A proverb says: "Diancang's snow, Erhai's moon, Shangguan's flowers, Xiaguan's wind."
translations.idiomatic: A local saying ran: "Snow on Diancang, moon over Erhai, flowers at Shangguan, wind at Xiaguan."

sentences.zh: 下關貿易極盛，南陬名鎮。

translations.literal: Xiaguan's trade is extremely flourishing—a famous town of the southern frontier.

translations.idiomatic: To the southwest: Huazang Mountain.

translations.literal: The Dajiang, also called the Boluo River, has two sources; united they flow north, pass south of the city, turn east to join the Yulang Spring, Wulong, Shuangta, and other waters, and enter Erhai to the north.
translations.idiomatic: The Dajiang, also known as the Boluo River, rose from two sources; united they flowed north past the south wall, turned east to join the Yulang Spring, Wulong, Shuangta, and other streams, and emptied northward into Erhai.

sentences.zh: 白崖江即禮社江，上流自雲南縣入，流經白崖，有鼻窗廠水及赤水江來會，入蒙化。

translations.idiomatic: One branch flowed south to Tuanshan Dam and divided into three.

sentences.zh: 其一南流為溪溝，逕青華山南，入趙州，為禮社江東源。

translations.literal: The first flows south as a stream gully, passes south of Qinghua Mountain, enters Zhaozhou, and is the eastern source of the Lishe River.
translations.idiomatic: The first flowed south as a stream channel past the south of Qinghua Mountain into Zhaozhou, forming the eastern source of the Lishe River.

sentences.zh: 其二東流，一逕縣南，匯為青龍海，一逕縣北，匯為品甸王海，仍歸青龍海，海周四十餘里，灌田利溥。

translations.literal: The second flows east; one course passes south of the county and gathers into Qinglong Lake, one passes north of the county and gathers into Pindianwanghai, then returns to Qinglong Lake; the lake is more than forty li in circumference and irrigates fields to great benefit.
translations.idiomatic: The second flowed east—one arm ran south of the county to form Qinglong Lake, another ran north of the county to form Pindianwanghai before rejoining Qinglong Lake; the lake measured more than forty li around and irrigated the fields to abundant profit.

translations.literal: The Luoshi River rises at Luyu Pool below Fuzhong Mountain, also called West Lake; it flows south past Xiangshan, then southeast to Shangguan.
translations.idiomatic: The Luoshi River rose at Luyu Pool beneath Fuzhong Mountain—also called West Lake—flowed south past Xiangshan, and continued southeast to Shangguan.

sentences.zh: 悶地江源出州東北焦石洞，亦曰東湖，南流逕城東，又南至上關，彌苴佉江自浪穹來注之，入洱海。

translations.literal: The Mendi River rises at Jiaoshi Cave northeast of the department, also called East Lake; it flows south past the east of the city, then south to Shangguan; the Mizhiju River comes from Langqiong to pour into it, and it enters Erhai.
translations.idiomatic: The Mendi River rose at Jiaoshi Cave northeast of the department seat—also called East Lake—flowed south past the east wall and on to Shangguan; the Mizhiju River entered from Langqiong to join it before the stream emptied into Erhai.

sentences.zh: 高澗河源出雞足山，北流，羅陋河自鶴慶來會，合為枯木河，入賓川。

translations.idiomatic: The Gaojian River rose on Jizu Mountain and flowed north; the Luolou River joined from Heqing; united they became the Kumu River and entered Binchuan.

translations.idiomatic: The Heihui River entered from Jianchuan—also called the Baishi River—flowed south past the west wall, absorbed various mountain streams, and upon entering Taihe became the Yangbei River.

translations.idiomatic: The Daying River rose in Jianchuan and flowed south; the Fengyu River rose at Qingyuan Cave and flowed north; both joined at the Ning River.

translations.literal: The Ning River rises at Bagu Mountain, gathers into Cibi Lake, flows south, passes northeast of the city, turns south to meet the Daying River, turns west, receives the Men and Fengyu rivers—the place is called Sanjiangkou.
translations.idiomatic: The Ning River rose on Bagu Mountain, pooled into Cibi Lake, flowed south past the northeast of the city, met the Daying River, turned west to absorb the Men and Fengyu rivers at a confluence called Sanjiangkou.

sentences.zh: 又南，逕城東蒲陀崆，為彌苴佉江，歷鄧川入太和，即洱海上源也。

translations.literal: Flowing south again, it passes Putuokong east of the city, becomes the Mizhiju River, passes through Dengchuan to enter Taihe—it is the upper source of Erhai.
translations.idiomatic: Flowing south again, it passed Putuokong east of the city, became the Mizhiju River, ran through Dengchuan into Taihe—the upper headwaters of Erhai.

translations.literal: The Dadan River is also called the Liuxi River; it has six sources, named Zhongliang Stream, Yin Stream, Shibao Stream, Hanxi Stream, Tong'er Stream, and Chilong Stream; all flow east from the west of the city, then turn north past the northwest of the city; the Fengle Stream comes from Hezikong Mountain to join them—it is also called the Qixi River—and flows north into the Jinsha River.
translations.idiomatic: The Dadan River was also called the Liuxi River. Its headwaters numbered six: Zhongliang Stream, Yin Stream, Shibao Stream, Hanxi Stream, Tong'er Stream, and Chilong Stream. All issued west of the city and flowed east, then turned north past the city's northwest corner. The Fengle Stream came from Hezikong Mountain to join them—also called the Qixi River—and flowed north into the Jinsha River.

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year of Qianlong it was changed to belong to the prefecture, and the Mengga, Kanghong, and Mengban three native company commanders were placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year of Qianlong it was changed to belong to the prefecture, and the Mengga, Kanghong, and Mengban three native company commanders were placed under it.

translations.literal: Southeast: Jicui and Tiechang mountains.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast: Jicui and Tiechang mountains.

translations.literal: Southwest: Xianrenjiao Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest: Xianrenjiao Mountain.

translations.literal: West: Boma.
translations.idiomatic: To the west: Boma.

translations.literal: North: Leiguan.
translations.idiomatic: To the north: Leiguan.

sentences.zh: 瀾滄江自鎮邊入，杉木江納景谷江、寶谷江水來會，入思茅。

translations.literal: The Lancang River enters from Zhenbian, the Shanmu River receives Jinggu and Baogu river waters to join it, and enters Simao.
translations.idiomatic: The Lancang River entered from Zhenbian, the Shanmu River received Jinggu and Baogu river waters to join it, and entered Simao.

sentences.zh: 猛撒江一名猛賴河，自鎮沅入，納暖里河、鐵廠河水，入寧洱。

translations.literal: The Mengsa River, also called the Menglai River, enters from Zhenyuan, receives Nuanli and Tiechang river waters, and enters Ning'er.
translations.idiomatic: The Mengsa River, also called the Menglai River, entered from Zhenyuan, received Nuanli and Tiechang river waters, and entered Ning'er.

translations.literal: The assistant administrator was stationed at Mengga.
translations.idiomatic: The assistant administrator was stationed at Mengga.

translations.literal: To the southwest was Gaguan.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest was Gaguan.

sentences.zh: 西香、抱母二鹽井，雍正三年設鹽大使，駐抱母。

translations.literal: Xixiang and Baomu two salt wells; in the third year of Yongzheng a salt intendant was established, stationed at Baomu.
translations.idiomatic: The Xixiang and Baomu two salt wells; in the third year of Yongzheng a salt intendant was established, stationed at Baomu.

sentences.zh: 八年移駐香鹽井，名抱香井，今改隸石膏井。

translations.literal: In the eighth year moved to Xiangyan Well, called Baoxiang Well, now changed to belong to the gypsum well.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year it was moved to Xiangyan Well, called Baoxiang Well, now changed to belong to the gypsum well.

translations.literal: Simao Subprefecture: of greatest importance.
translations.idiomatic: Simao Subprefecture: of greatest importance.

translations.literal: One hundred twenty li south of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred twenty li south of the prefecture.

translations.literal: In the Ming it was Cheli territory, called Simao Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the Ming it was Cheli territory, called Simao Stockade.

sentences.zh: 雍正十三年設廳治，分車裡九土司及攸樂土目地隸焉。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Yongzheng the subprefecture seat was established, dividing nine Cheli native chieftains and Youle native headman territory to be subordinate to it.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Yongzheng the subprefecture seat was established, dividing nine Cheli native chieftains and Youle native headman territory to be subordinate to it.

translations.literal: East: Yixiang and Tieshan.
translations.idiomatic: To the east: Yixiang and Tieshan.

translations.literal: West: Yuping and Liukun.
translations.idiomatic: To the west: Yuping and Liukun.

sentences.zh: 東南：六茶山：曰攸樂、曰蟒支、曰革登、曰蠻磚、曰倚邦、曰漫撒。

translations.literal: Southeast: the Six Tea Mountains: Youle, Mangzhi, Gedeng, Manzhuan, Yibang, and Mansa.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast: the Six Tea Mountains: Youle, Mangzhi, Gedeng, Manzhuan, Yibang, and Mansa.

translations.literal: Yiwu Mountain also produces tea.
translations.idiomatic: Yiwu Mountain also produced tea.

sentences.zh: 瀾滄江自威遠入，納猛撒江水，又東南，納南鍾、南勻諸水，繞九龍山麓，名九龍江，至車裡北。

translations.literal: The Lancang River enters from Weiyuan, receives Mengsa River waters, then southeast receives Nanzhong, Nanyun, and other waters, skirts the foot of Jiulong Mountain, called the Jiulong River, reaching north of Cheli.
translations.idiomatic: The Lancang River entered from Weiyuan, received Mengsa River waters, then southeast received Nanzhong, Nanyun, and other waters, skirted the foot of Jiulong Mountain, called the Jiulong River, reaching north of Cheli.

sentences.zh: 南哈河自遮放入，又東會羅梭江，東南入交阯。

translations.literal: The Nanha River enters from Zhefang, then east meets the Luosuo River and flows southeast into Annam.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanha River entered from Zhefang, then east met the Luosuo River and flowed southeast into Annam.

sentences.zh: 羅梭江上源為清水河，南流逕寧洱為大開河，仍流入境，納龍谷、猛臘諸水，又西南入九龍江。

translations.literal: The upper course of the Luosuo River is the Qingshui River, flowing south past Ning'er as the Dakai River, still flowing into the territory, receiving Longgu and Mengla waters, then southwest into the Jiulong River.
translations.idiomatic: The upper course of the Luosuo River was the Qingshui River, flowing south past Ning'er as the Dakai River, still flowing into the territory, receiving Longgu and Mengla waters, then southwest into the Jiulong River.

translations.literal: South: Yongjing Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the south: Yongjing Pass.

translations.literal: Southeast: Yixiang Pass.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast: Yixiang Pass.

translations.literal: Talang Subprefecture: of key importance.
translations.idiomatic: Talang Subprefecture: of key importance.

translations.literal: One hundred sixty li northeast of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred sixty li northeast of the prefecture.

translations.literal: In the Ming it was Gongshun Native Department.
translations.idiomatic: In the Ming it had been Gongshun Native Department.

sentences.zh: 順治十八年省入元江府。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Shunzhi it was abolished and incorporated into Yuanjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Shunzhi it was abolished and incorporated into Yuanjiang Prefecture.

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Yongzheng the subprefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Yongzheng the subprefecture was established.

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year of Qianlong it was changed to belong to the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year of Qianlong it was changed to belong to the prefecture.

translations.literal: East: Qiuxiang and Shuigui.
translations.idiomatic: To the east: Qiuxiang and Shuigui.

translations.literal: West: Hongyan, Menglian, Zhebi, and Lingshan.
translations.idiomatic: To the west: Hongyan, Menglian, Zhebi, and Lingshan.

translations.literal: Southeast: Taiji Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast: Taiji Mountain.

translations.literal: Southwest: Banle and Fashan.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest: Banle and Fashan.

sentences.zh: 把邊江自鎮沅入，逕寧洱，仍南流，至廳南入元江。

translations.literal: The Babian River enters from Zhenyuan, passes Ning'er, still flows south, and at the south of the subprefecture enters the Yuanjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Babian River entered from Zhenyuan, passed Ning'er, still flowed south, and at the south of the subprefecture entered the Yuanjiang.

sentences.zh: 阿墨江自鎮沅入，納慢會河水、他郎河水，為布固江。

translations.literal: The Amo River enters from Zhenyuan, receives Manhui and Talang river waters, becoming the Bugu River.
translations.idiomatic: The Amo River entered from Zhenyuan, received Manhui and Talang river waters, becoming the Bugu River.

translations.literal: Ning'er South Ping Lake gathers streams for irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: Ning'er South Ping Lake gathered streams for irrigation.

sentences.zh: 車裡宣慰司轄江外六版地。

translations.literal: The Cheli Pacification Commissioner governed the six districts beyond the river.
translations.idiomatic: The Cheli Pacification Commissioner governed the six districts beyond the river.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十八年宣慰司刁維屏潛逃，裁革。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year of Qianlong Pacification Commissioner Diao Weiping fled in secret and was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year of Qianlong Pacification Commissioner Diao Weiping fled in secret and was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，以刁土宛復襲。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year Diao Tuwan was restored to inherit the post.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year Diao Tuwan was restored to inherit the post.
